GameplayEvent Rules2 sections
Event Rules

◆ Use 1 Ball Ticket to draw for random rewards, including limited costumes. Tap Details to view the prizes.

◆ Get Ball Tickets by completing event tasks or purchasing exclusive event bundles.

◆ Duplicate costumes can be used to upgrade their levels.

◆ Reach certain draw counts to claim Progress Rewards.

◆ Each unused Ball Ticket will convert into 200 Crystals after the event ends.

Check-Ins

◆ Check in to the event to claim check-in rewards.

Event Rules

◆During the event, Transcenders can spend 1 Butterfly Net to draw a random reward, including the time-limited costume. Check the reward detail through Details.

◆During the event, Transcenders can obtain Butterfly Net through event tasks and limited bundles.

◆Duplicate costumes can be used to upgrade its level.

◆When Transcenders draw certain times, the corresponding Progress Rewards can be claimed.

◆Butterfly Net will be converted to Crystals x200 after the event ends.

Event Rules

◆ Use 1 gacha ticket to draw for random rewards, including limited costumes. Tap "Details" to view the prizes.

◆ Get gacha tickets by completing event tasks or purchasing exclusive event bundles.

◆Duplicate costumes can be used to upgrade its level.

◆ Reach certain draw counts to claim Progress Rewards.

◆ Each unused gacha ticket will convert into 200 crystals after the event ends.

Event Check-In

◆ Login to the game during the event to claim rewards.
